description: She wears an opaque red-brown floor-length court overdress with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length outer sleeves and narrow gold woven borders around neckline, cuffs, waist and front skirt edges. Cream underdress sleeves and a central cream underskirt show beneath. A decorated belt with round gold medallions circles the waist. A matching gold-patterned red-brown shoulder wrap rests along her forearms and hangs at both sides. Brown closed lace-up shoes are fully visible beneath the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon; opaque fabric covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis.
